style: Photoreal editorial fitness photograph in a minimal, dark home studio: matte charcoal wall and floor, one soft key light from the front and a single warm terracotta rim light from behind on one side, deep soft shadows, gentle film grain, true-to-life skin texture, calm and premium. No text, letters, numbers, logos, brand marks, watermarks, mirrors, screens or signage anywhere; clothing and equipment are plain and unbranded. Not a real or famous person.
